policy: Exact frozen questions/keys and raw same-question answers+evidence; no proposed grades or earlier outcomes.

question.question: State all five round phases in order, when Conflict and hand cards are drawn, and what Recall does if Endgame is not triggered.

fixed_key.expected_answer: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Start reveals top Conflict face up atop previous remaining cards then each draws five. If no Endgame, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise and begin next round (two-player Rival exception).

raw_response.answer: The five phases are Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. At Round Start first reveal a Conflict from the top of the deck and resolve any defensive troop bonus; then each player draws five cards from their deck. At Recall, if Endgame is not triggered, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise and start the next round.
raw_response.evidence: Turn Structure lists five phases and order; Phase 1 conflict reveal then defensive bonus then draw five; Phase 5 next-round procedure.

question.question: A House Hagal card shows a Signet Ring effect for the two-player Rival. Which ability is resolved, and does the Rival need a human Signet Ring card or a Reveal turn to trigger it?

fixed_key.expected_answer: Resolve the Signet Ring ability printed on the selected Rival card as the Hagal effect. No human deck Signet Ring card or Reveal turn is involved; Rival never Reveals.
fixed_key.source_references: Supplements PDF pp3–4 Rival card anatomy and House Hagal Signet Ring icon
fixed_key.novelty: Rival Hagal Signet trigger distinct from human Signet Ring Agent-card trigger

raw_response.answer: The Rival resolves the Signet Ring/Scheme ability printed on its Rival card. It is part of the revealed Hagal effect and does not require a human Signet Ring card or any Reveal turn; the Rival never Reveals.
raw_response.evidence: Rival Agent turns: apply revealed Hagal effects including Signet Ring; Rival never takes a Reveal turn; follows printed Signet Ring and Scheme abilities.

question.question: State all five round phases in order, when Conflict and hand cards are drawn, and what Recall does if Endgame is not triggered.

fixed_key.expected_answer: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Start reveals top Conflict face up atop previous remaining cards then each draws five. If no Endgame, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise and begin next round (two-player Rival exception).

raw_response.answer: The phases are Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. At Round Start reveal the top Conflict card and place it face up on top of any unclaimed Conflict cards remaining from earlier rounds, resolve control defense, then each player draws five cards. If Endgame is not triggered at Recall, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise, and start the next round.
raw_response.evidence: Turn Structure lists phases; Round Start reveals Conflict before drawing five; Recall describes next-round preparation.
